title: Conditional control head positions
statement: Let $D,M_1,M_2$ be finite Turing machines over the Boolean alphabet, let $x$ be a Boolean word, and let $c$ be a configuration of $D$ on input $x$. The vector of work-tape head positions in the conditional machine's control configuration constructed from $c$ equals the vector consisting of $D$'s head positions in $c$, zero positions for the tapes of $M_1$ and $M_2$, and the length of $c$'s output as the final coordinate.
